templates.name: legal-page
templates.description: Legal long-form text page: an <h1> title, gold sub-section labels promoted to <h2>, plus paragraphs and bulleted lists in a narrow reading column. All default content, no blocks. Shared by every /legal/ page across all site roots (us, ww, ent, stroke-awareness, zip-skin-closure).

templates.name: procedure-detail
templates.description: IVS treatment/procedure detail page. Zones top-to-bottom: (1) hero (banner) title + Find a doctor CTA; (2) a 'flex' section with a default-content intro on the left and a panel (cta) benefits card on the right; (3) a full-bleed dark panel (dark wide) clinical-evidence band in a 'dark' section; (4) an h3 'How it works' heading + a cards block (3 steps: image + h4 + text); (5) a panel (gold) mid-page CTA; (6) an h2 'Resources' heading + a cards (resources) block (brochure cards); (7) a 'compact' section of default-content risks + references. Header/footer and the Marketo doctor-locator form are stripped on import. All variants reuse existing project blocks — no new block code.

templates.name: patient-information
templates.description: Neurovascular Patient Information page (standalone, styled via the `patient-information` theme in styles/themes.css): gold title bar (hero band), an intro line, a row of patient-guide brochure cards (cards brochure-cta) linking to PDFs and product pages with a gold product CTA button, a gold 'for more information' CTA band (section style: gold, full-bleed), a 3-column resources footer authored inline as `columns (related-links)` (variant owns the link/CTA display) in a `light-gray, full-bleed` section (section owns the gray band), and a trademark/disclaimer block. Reuses existing blocks only (hero, cards, columns). This page shares no layout with any sibling, so it uses a theme rather than a shared template.

templates.name: sa-resources
templates.description: Stroke Awareness Resources landing page: hero banner, a two-column intro (default text + gold button beside a light panel) in a flex/compact section, a 4-up downloads card grid (cards brochure), a social-media card grid (cards brochure with empty heading line), a related-links fragment reference in a gray section, and a small-text disclaimer. Standalone template for future SA resource-style pages.

templates.name: ivs-home
templates.description: IVS patient homepage (standalone singleton, styled via the `ivs-home` theme in styles/themes.css). Zones top-to-bottom: (1) hero (banner) 'Pain doesn't hold the power. You do.' + Find a doctor CTA; (2) a sticky-nav in-page anchor bar (Overview/Testimonials/Find a Doctor/Resources/Disclaimer); (3) a 'flex' intro section — default 'Making every moment matter.' text left + a video block right; (4) a gold panel band 'There's hope ahead'; (5) a 4-up cards (linked) pain-type grid (back/neck, knee, hip, shoulder); (6) a statistics dashboard (6 metrics, two 3-up rows); (7) a 'flex' section of two panel (cta) spotlights (VCF; radiofrequency ablation); (8) two testimonial columns (Janet; Lynn) on a dark-teal band — text left + video right; (9) a gold panel band 'Tired of living in pain?'; (10) a marketo-form doctor-finder; (11) a 'Resources' heading + tabs block whose six tabs reference the brochure card fragments under /fragments/resources/ (preceded by a spacer section, same as the conditions pages); (12) a 'compact' disclaimer/references section. Header/footer and the runtime Scene7 video chrome are stripped on import; all mapped blocks reuse existing project blocks — no new block code.

templates.name: ivs-treatment
templates.description: Interventional Spine (IVS) treatment page (mild® procedure). Sections: full-bleed hero (photo + H1 + gold CTA); a flex side-by-side section pairing default text ('Get back on your feet') with a white 'Benefits of the treatment' panel; a dark teal 'What is LSS?' section (columns 70-30, text + DM diagram); a 'proven results' section (default heading/intro above a default 2-up columns block of DM stat charts); a dark teal Before/After comparison (default 2-up columns, DM diagrams); a 'How it works' section (default heading above a 3-up text-only columns block); a gold 'Tired of living in pain?' CTA panel; a Resources cards grid (brochure-cta, 2 PDF thumbnails); a light-gray 'Potential risks' default-content block; and a compact inline disclaimer + footnotes region. Standalone template for future IVS treatment pages. All DM/Scene7 images round-trip via the shared patients-stryker-dm-images transformer. The physician-contact Marketo form between the CTA and Resources is not migrated.

sections.name: Get back on your feet + Benefits panel (side-by-side)
Tired of living in pain? (CTA panel)

templates.name: ivs-get-the-facts
templates.description: Interventional Spine (IVS) 'Get the facts' page (vertebral compression fractures). Same source skin as the mild page (ivs-treatment) and reuses its parsers/transformers, but its own section structure and standalone `ivs-get-the-facts` theme. Sections: full-bleed hero (photo + H1 + H2 + gold CTA, section style `hero-facts`); a flex side-by-side section pairing default text ('What is a VCF?') with a white 'More about VCFs' panel; a dark teal 'Why is treatment important?' section (columns 50-50, text + DM diagram); a divider section ('Don't just manage the pain', h1 + text + LEARN MORE button); a gold 'Tired of living in pain?' CTA panel; the physician-contact Marketo form; and a compact inline disclaimer + footnotes region.

sections.name: What is a VCF? + More about VCFs panel (side-by-side)
Don't just manage the pain (text + button)
Tired of living in pain? (CTA panel)

templates.name: bvn-ablation
templates.description: Basivertebral nerve ablation (BVNA) IVS treatment page — SINGLETON (not part of procedure-detail), styled via the `bvn-ablation` theme in styles/themes.css. Sections: hero (banner) + Find a doctor; flex intro text + panel (cta, wide) benefits; flex+dark band of default text beside a DM video block; statistics (count-up, cols-2) + panel (gray) symptoms box; How it works H3 + 4-step columns (library "Columns – Steps (4 up)"); What you can expect H3 + 3-up text columns; panel (gold) CTA; Marketo find-a-doctor form; Resources H2 + tabs (library "Tabs – Resources by treatment"), one tab per source tab linking its brochure card fragment; light-gray potential risks; compact footnotes/references. Existing blocks only; parsers/transformers under bvn-ablation/ are copies so template changes don't affect it.

templates.name: ivs-contact
templates.description: IVS Contact us page (standalone): page title, intro, Marketo contact form, Find a doctor CTA, compact disclaimer.

templates.name: search
templates.description: ENT site search page — SINGLETON. Default content plus one block: h1 'Search Results', h2 'Showing results for:', a Search block (placeholder text only — the block builds the same form as the header search), the no-results message and suggestions list. Hidden inputs and the Load more button are dropped. Styled via the `search` theme.

templates.name: doctor-request
templates.description: IVS find-a-doctor Doctor Request page — SINGLETON, styled via the `doctor-request` theme in styles/themes.css. Default-content h1 + intro paragraphs followed by the existing marketo-form block (physician locator sign-up). The post-submit thank-you message is dropped. Header/footer stripped on import.

templates.name: zip-doctor-request
templates.description: Zip Skin Closure find-a-doctor Doctor Request page — SINGLETON, styled via the `zip-doctor-request` theme in styles/themes.css. Default-content h1 (fixed 24.5px gold Futura) + two intro paragraphs (14px light serif, trailing bold run kept as <strong>), a full-width rule, then the marketo-form block (form 4380). The post-submit thank-you message and the Last Updated stamp are dropped; Zip header/footer resolve by path.

templates.name: news-shared-fragments
templates.description: stryker.com news-detail shared Experience Fragments (#443), imported from their XF master URLs as fragment documents at the short paths in tools/importer/xf-fragment-map.js (XF path from the customer export → /us/en/fragments/…): business-unit Resources links (columns), Sustainability "Connect with us" band, Sustainability and Sage contact asides, and the Join our talent network banner. Pages include them with the fragment block.

templates.name: news-detail
templates.description: www.stryker.com news feature articles (/us/en/about/news/YEAR/features/). Title section (H1 only when the source has one, H5 publish date); lead media: single-slide autocarousel as Hero Corp (image-slide) with the source headline position/size as variant options, or a standalone image; article sections (rich text, images, Video block) in the 66.66% centred column (template CSS); centred rich text + gold curated CTA as a `center` section; references and document code as a small-print `disclaimer` section; `published` metadata drives the corp Last Updated line.

templates.name: news-detail-forms
templates.description: www.stryker.com news-detail articles with a Marketo form (#446), imported with import-news-detail.js. The form is the `marketo-form` block with the base URL, Munchkin ID and form ID of the source form (no captcha rows; the thank-you text and redirect are not carried). A shared contact Experience Fragment beside the form (2/3 + 1/3 row) is a `fragment` block in the same section (`form-with-aside`); the Sustainability "Connect with us" band is a `fragment` block in its own section.

templates.name: news-detail-xf
templates.description: www.stryker.com news articles whose body is an Experience Fragment (#462; import-news-xf.js). As news-detail, plus: shared XFs (business-unit Resources links) as a fragment block before the small print; XF grid rows with two or more filled cells as Columns (variant from the column spans); blank titles and spacers dropped; Futura bold 2em-2.5em paragraphs as the H1 and ruled feature subheads as underlined H2s (gold rule); a dimensional box as Panel (left); news typography (#441).

templates.name: long-page-detail-corp
templates.description: www.stryker.com long-page-detail pages (#469): H1 title; Virtual Learning Center video section (underlined H2 title, Video block, H3 description, Cards Corp (resources) downloads) or a shared Experience Fragment as a Fragment block; video detail pages (Video + caption); text articles; small print and document code as a `disclaimer` section; `published` with `last-updated: false` (the corp Last Updated line is not shown for now).

templates.name: event-detail
templates.description: www.stryker.com event pages (/us/en/global-events/**, #499). The H2 event title becomes the H1; the event fields go in one Columns (columns-67-33): main cell = Meeting time / Location / Country / Contact (H5 + text), Details and Registration as underlined H5s (divider convention) with their text, the bold "Disclaimer:" paragraph and the register link in bold (primary button); sidebar cell = Related links or empty. Customizable Area extras (e.g. Contact Us, PDFs) follow as default content in their own section; a document code (.c-disclaimer, e.g. "1000903067 Rev A") as a small-print `disclaimer` section. Map, PRINT and ADD TO CALENDAR are dropped; the event facts are kept as event-* page metadata (ISO start/end, timezone, location, country, registration, contact). Template CSS (templates/event-detail) sets the Futura bold title and 14px field headings.

templates.name: contact-division
templates.description: www.stryker.com division "Contact us" pages (#509): H1; contact details as an underlined H2 + Columns (columns-50-50) block (addresses, H4 labels, tel:/mailto:/plain links | Google Maps link); Customizable Area in source order: section titles (underlined H2, title id as section id), rich text, Marketo Form blocks (a form beside text in a 1/3 + 2/3 row as a `flex, flex-33-67` / `flex, flex-67-33` section), AEM division contact forms as heading + description only, a shared Experience Fragment as a Fragment block; document numbers as a `disclaimer` section; `published` with `last-updated: show`.

templates.name: people
templates.description: www.stryker.com People pages (#515): 19 leader and 10 director bios (Back link Fragment, H1 with gold first name + role in a `serif, p-1-75, h1-1-25` section, Columns [bio | portrait]) and the leaders index (H1 + intro in `serif, p-2`, an H2 per group, Cards Corp (people) tiles). Script: tools/importer/import-people.js.

templates.name: people-fragments
templates.description: Back link Experience Fragments of the People bio pages (#515), imported from their XF master URLs as fragment documents at the paths in tools/importer/xf-fragment-map.js. Script: tools/importer/import-people-fragments.js.

templates.name: ivs-footnotes
templates.description: www.stryker.com Interventional Spine footnotes (#516): index (hero, Accordion (divided) in a `separator` section, "View past revisions" gold buttons) and detail pages (Back link Fragment, hero with the document code subhead in an `h-serif` section, revisions with bold [[text-1-25]] labels, [[body-font]] dates and numbered references; a `separator` section only when the hero has no subhead); the source document code as a closing `disclaimer` section; `published`, `last-updated: show`, `site: corp`.

templates.name: ivs-footnotes-fragments
templates.description: Back link Experience Fragment of the Interventional Spine footnote detail pages (#516), imported as a fragment document from a detail page: a bold + underlined link in a `no-arrow` section.

templates.name: corp-legal
templates.description: www.stryker.com legal, governance and policy pages (#517): legal notices, governance bylaws and charters, policy and DFU pages, built as the long-page-detail-corp pages; source tables (.c-table) become `Table (no-header, striped)` blocks. Script: tools/importer/import-corp-legal.js.
